text:
Maya Chen: Quick sync 1 chart polish notes — legend truncation, axis precision, smoothing defaults, and how we surface extreme spikes. Keeping this short.
Aisha Khan: Saw the live preview. Two issues: long series names get ellipsized in the legend with no hover tooltip, and when wrapped the spacing looks off on mobile.
Diego Marquez: Also noticed axis tick labels sometimes show `0.0k` for small values. We should hide trailing zeros (12.0k -> 12k) and avoid `0.0` on compact units.
Sam Wu: I prototyped three approaches for outliers: 1) soft clamp at 99th percentile with marker + tooltip, 2) switch to log scale, 3) split axis (secondary axis for extremes). My pick is clamp+marker + small inset minimap that preserves the full distribution.
Maya Chen: For legend UX: option A = tooltip on hover showing full series name; option B = expandable legend where long names stack. Prefer A for compact dashboards, B for detailed pages. Need keyboard support either way.
Aisha Khan: Accessibility pick: always expose the full-name tooltip as an aria-describedby element for screen readers, and provide a `Expand legend` button for keyboard users that toggles full view.
Diego Marquez: About smoothing: add two toggles: `Trend smoothing (7)` and `None`. Default to `None` for alerting views. When smoothing is active, show a subtle dashed overlay of raw values so users can see peaks.
Sam Wu: Visual cue for clipping: dashed horizontal cap at clip threshold + small badge on the series point `Clipped` that opens a modal listing the top N clipped samples. Tooltip should say actual value and percentile.
Design System Bot: Reminder: all legend text on bg-gray-50 must be >= 4.5:1. Current moss-green token fails. Suggested replacement #146A5A meets 4.7:1.
Maya Chen: Units decision: axis ticks use compact SI with trimmed decimals; tooltips always show full value + full unit (e.g., "12345 traces"). Add an option to toggle decimal precision (auto / 1 / 2).
Aisha Khan: Keyboard interactions: Tab into legend, arrow keys move between items, Space toggles visibility, Enter opens expand modal. Provide live region updates like "Series <name> hidden" for screen readers.
Diego Marquez: Export behavior: exports must contain raw values. If smoothing/clipping applied in view, show a banner: "Exporting raw data. Current chart view has smoothing/clipping applied."
Sam Wu: Config snippet from prototype (for engineers):
```
"yUnit": "traces",
"tickFormat": "si-compact-trim",
"precision": "auto",
"smoothing": "none",
"outlier": "clip_99_with_inset",
"legend": "tooltip|expand",
"keyboardLegend": true
```
Maya Chen: Action items: Maya update legend tooltip and mobile wrap; Aisha write keyboard/aria spec and live region copy; Diego tidy tick formatting and export banner copy; Sam implement clip badge + inset and dashed raw overlay; Design System Bot will validate token changes. Review next Tue.
Design System Bot: Preview of updated tokens and a11y checks available at https://preview.redwood-inference.com/preview/legend-clip-1767. Please test with VoiceOver/NVDA and color-blind simulators.
Maya Chen: Great work team, thanks. Closing thread.
